title: Rook X-Ray on the d-File
story: Black lined up the queen IN FRONT of the rook on the open file. Attack the queen — when she runs, the rook falls!

title: Skewer the Battery
story: White stacked the queen in front of the rook on the e-file. Your rook attacks both at once — the queen cannot stay!

title: The Long Diagonal Sting
story: Black's queen and bishop share the same long diagonal. Slide your bishop onto it — the queen must flee and the bishop is yours!

title: Raid from h6
story: White's early queen stands on the same diagonal as the sleeping bishop on c1. Skewer them both!

title: Bishop Spears the Queen
story: The black queen stepped in front of her own rook on the light diagonal. Spear her — the rook is the prize!

title: Battery Backfire
story: White lined up queen and bishop, aiming at your king. But the queen stands in FRONT — slide your bishop out, guarded by its pawn, and skewer her! When she runs, the bishop behind her is yours.
